description: Ladybug Tools is a collection of free, open-source applications that support environmental design and education by connecting 3D CAD interfaces to validated simulation engines: Radiance, EnergyPlus and OpenStudio, THERM and WINDOW, and OpenFOAM. It runs inside 3D modelling and parametric visual scripting environments, so geometry creation, simulation and visualisation happen in one interface; its modular components suit different design stages and research questions, automate tasks and produce interactive 3D graphics, animations and data visualisations. It is written in Python, runs on virtually any operating system, and the site reports more than 500,000 downloads, making it the third most downloaded plugin for Grasshopper; development follows the consensus of an open community with an online forum, and a subscription Ladybug Tools Academy offers developer-led tutorials. Coverage: generic; any site with a weather file. Access: free download. Licence: the core ladybug library is under the GNU AGPL version 3. Caveats: results depend on the underlying engines and user settings, and it runs inside a host CAD program; the plugin repository was at tag v1.72.5 when checked. Simulation uses: outdoor thermal comfort and heat studies of public spaces, daylight and energy analysis, and parametric design optimisation. Related records: EnergyPlus, OpenStudio, OpenFOAM, THERM and WINDOW, and Pollination.
